description: Implementation of the InterfaceStackClientReqHandler class, which manages TR-069 host interface requests related to InterfaceStack, including get/set operations, notifications, and update checks.

classes.name: InterfaceStackClientReqHandler
classes.description: Handles TR-069 host interface requests for InterfaceStack, including get/set operations, notifications, and update checks.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the current number of interface stack entries.

methods.name: unInit
methods.description: De-initializes the handler and closes all interface stack instances.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles set message requests; currently not supported.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles get message requests for number of entries and interface attributes.

methods.name: handleGetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Retrieves notification enable status for interface stack parameters.

methods.name: handleSetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Sets notification enable status for interface stack parameters.

methods.name: registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for update events.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for interface stack updates and triggers callbacks for changes.
